text:
sre-bot: [ALERT] kvcache_paging_rate_high - pool=embed-prod hosts=6/24 paging_rate=820/s threshold=200/s -> auto-escalation to P1

emma: paging — getting lots of 5xx errors for embedding endpoints, 95p latency spiking, KV cache size climbing steadily. starting thread. @raj can you grab oncall?

raj: taking. observed continuous-batching queue lengths growing, many long seq requests interleaved with short embeds. looks like packer is coalescing long ones and starving small requests.

luke: can you paste a sample of recent scheduler metrics? curious about max_batch_size / pack_window.

raj: metrics snippet:```
pool: embed-prod
active_hosts: 24
kv_cache_entries: 18.2M -> 42.7M (1h)
evictions/s: 1200
pack_window_ms: 150
max_batch_tokens: 8192
avg_req_tokens: short=64, long=4096
95p_latency: 1420ms
error_rate(embed): 4.8%
```

nicole: that's a cache blowout. prefetching + long-request packing causing huge KV growth and paging. Lots of hosts are hitting swap-backed paging.

emma: customer impact: multiple search/embedding customers reporting failures. @customer-success can you list accounts impacted?

customer-success: quick list from alerts -> acct-omega, atlasai, neonsearch. CS contacted acct-omega (enterprise) — they're seeing embed timeouts and elevated error rates. prepping customer comms.

luke: short mitigation: reduce pack_window and cap batch sizes for embed-prod, then roll out to canary 3 hosts to confirm regression doesn't reappear. also disable prefetch for that pool. Proposed override:```json
{"pool":"embed-prod","pack_window_ms":20,"max_batch_tokens":1024,"disable_prefetch":true}
```

raj: on it. applying override to canary hosts now. running command:```bash
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/scheduler/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SCHED_KEY' -d '{"pool":"embed-prod","pack_window_ms":20,"max_batch_tokens":1024,"disable_prefetch":true,"reason":"kb-blowout emergency"}'
```

sre-bot: Deploy job started: scheduler-override -> canary hosts (3) by raj. build 2026.3.45

nicole: telemetry after override (10m):```
pack_window_ms: 20
kv_cache_entries delta (10m): +0.4M (vs +6.2M before)
95p_latency: 1420ms -> 360ms
evictions/s: 1200 -> 90
error_rate(embed): 4.8% -> 0.6%
```

emma: nice, big improvement. how's CPU on the canary hosts? any regression in throughput?

raj: CPU up slightly but within headroom. throughput per host stable. will start rolling to next 6, then remaining with careful watch.

alex: created INC-2026-1789, linking to top-customer alert and CS notes. drafting banner for status page. @customer-success coordinate comms.

customer-success: sending out initial notification to acct-omega and neonsearch with ETA for fix. asked for logs; they're collecting request IDs.

luke: follow-up config we should push to infra repo to avoid recurrence: lower default pack_window for mixed workloads + add heuristic to not pack long requests with small ones. opening PR.

nicole: also recommend adding a safeguard: if kv_cache_growth_rate > X then auto-throttle prefetch and reduce batch size. filed FR in backlog.

tier2-oncall: I'll stay on for the handoff window. @raj can you prepare a short runbook note for night team? include rollback steps.

raj: handoff note:
- symptom: paging spike, kvcache growth, embed errors
- immediate mitigation: scheduler override to pack_window_ms=20, max_batch_tokens=1024, disable_prefetch=true
- rollback: POST same endpoint with previous values or remove override tag to revert to global config
- monitoring: watch 95p_latency, kv_cache_entries delta, evictions/s, host swap usage
- customer comms: link INC-2026-1789

emma: handing to night oncall @luke at 04:30 UTC. I'll keep watch for 30m then log out.

luke: taking handoff. will continue rolling updates and validate once all hosts are patched. if anything regresses, revert override and escalate to eng-runtime.

sre-bot: Incident P1 created: INC-2026-1789 assigned to embed-prod oncall. severity=P1, status=mitigated->rolling.

emma: thumbs — great teamwork. postmortem follow-up: root cause hints at packer heuristics not distinguishing long seq workloads; include regression window and metrics in postmortem.

alex: I'll update the executive summary and customer impact timeline after final roll completes.

luke: will check again after full rollout. closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions show up.
